summary: Batch program that reads every record from the indexed ACCOUNT master file (ACCTFILE) and writes each account out to four output files in different layouts: a flat fixed record (OUTFILE), an array/table record (ARRYFILE), and two variable-length records (VBRCFILE). For each account it reformats the reissue date by calling the assembler routine COBDATFT. Any file I/O error prints the file status and abends the program.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Announce start of CBACT01C. Open the account input file and all output files (OUTFILE, ARRYFILE, VBRCFILE). Loop until end-of-file: read the next account record and, while not at end-of-file, display it. When done, close the account file, announce end of execution, and return to the caller.
paragraphs.notes: Driver paragraph (the code directly under PROCEDURE DIVISION); classic sequential read-process loop.

paragraphs.name: 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next account record into ACCOUNT-RECORD. If the read succeeded (status '00'): reset result to OK, clear the array record, then display, populate and write the flat account record, populate and write the array record, and populate and write the two variable-length records. If status is '10' set result to end-of-file (16); any other status is an error (12). Then: if OK continue; if end-of-file mark END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; otherwise report the read error, save the status and abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE (abend)
paragraphs.notes: Core per-record processing paragraph; uses status-code 88-levels APPL-AOK (0) and APPL-EOF (16) as control flags.

paragraphs.name: 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Print each field of the account record (id, active status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, open/expiration/reissue dates, current-cycle credit and debit, group id) followed by a divider line.
paragraphs.notes: Diagnostic display only; no business logic.

paragraphs.name: 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Copy the account fields into the flat OUTFILE record. Move the reissue date into the date-conversion structure, set conversion type and out-type to '2', and call the assembler routine COBDATFT to reformat the date; store the formatted date into the output record. Copy current-cycle credit. If the current-cycle debit is zero, force the output debit to 2525.00. Copy the group id.

annotations.note: Hard-coded 2525.00 substituted when cycle debit is zero -- looks like demo/test data, not a real business rule; flag for SME review.

paragraphs.notes: Calls external assembler COBDATFT for date formatting (resolved static CALL).

paragraphs.name: 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the flat account record to OUTFILE. If the write status is neither '00' nor '10', print the status, save it and abend.
branches: IF OUTFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND NOT = '10' -> error
paragraphs.notes: Standard write-with-status-check pattern repeated across the write paragraphs.

paragraphs.name: 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the array (table) record: set the account id, then fill the first three occurrences of the balance/debit table with the current balance and hard-coded cycle-debit amounts (1005.00, 1525.00, and negative -1025.00 / -2500.00 for the third slot).

annotations.note: Hard-coded amounts populating the OCCURS table -- demo data, not derived from the input; flag for SME review.

paragraphs.notes: Writes into an OCCURS 5 TIMES table (only first 3 slots populated).

paragraphs.name: 1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the array record to ARRYFILE. If status is neither '00' nor '10', print the status, save it and abend.
branches: IF ARRYFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND NOT = '10' -> error

paragraphs.name: 1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the two variable-length records: move the account id into both, active status into record 1, and current balance, credit limit and reissue year into record 2. Display both records.

paragraphs.name: 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set the record length to 12, copy variable record 1 into the variable output area, and write it. If status is neither '00' nor '10', print the status, save it and abend.
branches: IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND NOT = '10' -> error
paragraphs.notes: Uses reference modification VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN) for variable-length write.

paragraphs.name: 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set the record length to 39, copy variable record 2 into the variable output area, and write it. If status is neither '00' nor '10', print the status, save it and abend.
branches: IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND NOT = '10' -> error

paragraphs.name: 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the account file for input. If the open status is '00' set result OK, else set error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print an open error, save the status and abend.
paragraphs.notes: File-open pattern (repeated for each of the four files).

paragraphs.name: 2000-OUTFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open OUTFILE for output. If status '00' set OK, else error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print an open error, save the status and abend.

paragraphs.name: 3000-ARRFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open ARRYFILE for output. If status '00' set OK, else error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print an open error, save the status and abend.

paragraphs.name: 4000-VBRFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open VBRCFILE for output. If status '00' set OK, else error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print an open error, save the status and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the account file. If status '00' clear the result to OK, else set error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print a close error, save the status and abend.
paragraphs.notes: Uses ADD/SUBTRACT GIVING to set the result flag instead of MOVE.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Print 'ABENDING PROGRAM', set timing to 0 and abend code to 999, and call the system abend routine CEE3ABD to terminate the job abnormally.
paragraphs.notes: Calls Language Environment service CEE3ABD for a forced abend (resolved static CALL to an external system routine).

paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and display the file status code. If the status is non-numeric or its first byte is '9', decode the second byte as a binary number and show it as a 4-digit value; otherwise show the two-digit status right-justified in a 4-digit field.
branches: IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' ... ELSE
paragraphs.notes: Generic file-status display helper reused throughout; handles VSAM extended (9nn) status codes.
